```scheme
(define chest 'sword)
chest
```

```scheme
(set! chest 'gold)
chest
```

```scheme
(define (make-countdown n)
 (lambda ()
  (define last-n n)
  (cond
   ((zero? n)
    0)
   (else
    (begin
     (set! n (- n 1))
      last-n)))))
```

```scheme
(define cdown (make-countdown 3))
```

```scheme
(cdown)
```

```scheme

vec
```


